caption:
A swordswoman cuts through an entire army.
Seedance 2.5 lit up this whole courtyard.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 29 seconds. 16:9 landscape (1280x720). Ultra-photorealistic AAA live-action samurai epic: real skin, lacquered iron armor, wet stone and wood texture, night lit almost entirely by a huge blood-red full moon and the crimson glow of one katana, deep black shadows, crimson-and-charcoal color grade, light mist and drizzle haze, natural motion blur, 24-35mm wide lenses with shallow depth of field. Camera feel: one continuous, never-resting take - aggressive orbits, low-angle tracking, FPV pursuit, crash zooms and fast whip pans - interrupted by only two hard cuts at 00:20.5 and 00:22.4. Pacing: a slow, menacing walk for 3 seconds, then relentless nonstop combat; brief slow motion only on the biggest impacts; ends mid-battle with no victory pose and no fade.

CHARACTERS:
- THE WARRIOR: a young East Asian woman, about 22, pale skin, sharp straight dark eyebrows, dark narrow eyes, small closed mouth, cold fearless expression that never changes. Long jet-black hair pulled into a HIGH PONYTAIL with a few loose strands framing her face (tied back in every shot, swinging hard when she spins). Black layered kimono-style jacket with a crossed collar, a black lacquered lamellar shoulder guard with red lacing on her right shoulder, black armored forearm guards, a wide DARK-RED waist sash, black pleated hakama trousers, black boots. Signature: a single katana with a dark hilt whose entire blade glows CRIMSON like heated metal, held one-handed in her right hand.
- THE ARMY: dozens of armored foot soldiers in dark iron-grey lamellar armor with dark-red lacing, round dark helmets, straw sandals, katanas and spears, faces shadowed; they surround her in loose ranks across the courtyard.
- THE COMMANDER: a massive armored samurai, a head taller and twice as broad as the soldiers: heavy dark iron-grey plate-and-lamellar armor with red lacing, huge shoulder plates, a rust-orange cloth sash at the waist, a helmet with tall golden crescent horns, a long curved two-handed sword.

LOCATION: the huge stone-paved inner courtyard of an ancient Japanese castle at night. Large dark grey stone slabs, soaking wet with shallow puddles that mirror red light. Around it, long white plaster walls topped with black tiled roofs; at the far end a big wooden gatehouse with a heavy curved black tiled roof; on one side a wooden hall with a raised veranda and a long wooden railing. Sky: churning dark-crimson storm clouds and an enormous blood-red full moon, mostly hanging just above the gatehouse roof.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:03.0) — The walk. Medium shot from the front, slightly low angle, camera dollying slowly backward ahead of her. She walks slowly toward the lens, katana held low and loose in her right hand, its crimson blade glowing beside her leg; red light glistens in the puddles at frame left. Behind her the army advances in a loose semicircle, the gatehouse and the red glow of the moon at the top of frame. Her eyes stay locked on the lens.
SHOT 2 (00:03.0-00:04.0) — Attack from behind. A soldier charges from the right background with his katana raised over his head. She pivots instantly to her left, blocks his sword with the glowing blade (metal clang), and spins into a powerful kick that sends him crashing onto the stones. Camera whip-pans with her turn (no cut), heavy motion blur.
SHOT 3 (00:04.0-00:05.0) — The blood moon. Low-angle tracking shot close to the wet ground: she lunges forward in a deep low stance, crimson blade held out horizontally; the kicked soldier lies sprawled on the stones at right. MUST SHOW: the enormous blood-red full moon filling the upper middle of the frame directly behind the gatehouse roof.
SHOT 4 (00:05.0-00:08.0) — Veranda duel. Fast whip pan right (no cut) to a wide side view in front of the wooden hall's veranda and railing. She trades rapid blows with one soldier: deflects his katana with an orange spark burst at 00:05.5, ducks a horizontal swing, counters one-handed, the crimson blade leaving short red streaks. At the end a struck soldier tumbles toward the lens in blurred foreground.
SHOT 5 (00:08.0-00:10.5) — Over the railing. Camera swings low and tilts up at the hall. Three soldiers attack at once; she leaps onto the wooden railing, flips high over their blades up near the curved roof eave (the crimson blade a red streak against the dark roof), and lands behind them on the far side in a crouch beside fallen soldiers.
SHOT 6 (00:10.5-00:12.0) — Blade to the moon. Low angle from behind her: she rises into a wide stance facing the whole army across the courtyard, blade down at her right side, then raises the katana high above her head toward the blood moon at top left. Camera orbits slowly around her left side.
SHOT 7 (00:12.0-00:15.0) — Crimson lightning. Continuing low orbit to a three-quarter view from behind-left: she sinks into a deep low stance and extends the katana horizontally to frame right. MUST SHOW: the blade's glow stretches into a long beam of crimson light reaching across the courtyard, and from 00:13.5 jagged crimson lightning crawls along the blade and crackles outward to the right, lighting her back and the wet stones red. The blood moon hangs huge at top center above the gatehouse; the army waits in the background.
SHOT 8 (00:15.0-00:17.0) — The charge. FPV pursuit from behind and slightly above: she sprints straight at the army with explosive speed, blade trailing a crimson energy streak and faint afterimages (not teleporting). At 00:16.5 she cuts a wide horizontal sweep: MUST SHOW: a glowing crimson arc ribbon of light the width of the frame; the front rank is knocked off its feet by the shockwave, water and debris flying.
SHOT 9 (00:17.0-00:19.5) — Breaking the ranks. Camera circles tightly around her as she spins through the soldiers: blade hits with bursts of orange sparks, armored men stumble backward and fall, crimson streaks hang in the air, and thin glowing red cracks open in the wet stones under her feet. Over her shoulder the COMMANDER appears in front of the gatehouse, golden horns catching the moonlight.
SHOT 10 (00:19.5-00:20.5) — The commander. Camera behind her left shoulder: she faces the giant commander a few meters away; she raises her crimson blade high, leaving a red trail, as he lifts his long sword above his head.
SHOT 11 (00:20.5-00:22.4) — HARD CUT. Close medium two-shot in side view, warrior at frame left, commander at frame right, army blurred behind. They exchange fast, heavy strikes; the steel sword and the crimson blade collide in front of their faces with big bursts of orange sparks (00:21.5 and 00:22.0). Her face stays cold.
SHOT 12 (00:22.4-00:24.0) — HARD CUT. Low angle from behind the commander, his armored back and shoulder plates filling the right side of frame. He swings his huge sword in a flat final arc; she ducks beneath it, the crimson blade dragging a red streak, then springs up and vaults over his shoulder.
SHOT 13 (00:24.0-00:26.5) — The spinning slash. Camera low, tilting up as she flips high over the commander against the crimson clouds, the glowing blade drawing a curved red trail. In brief slow motion she spins in mid-air: MUST SHOW: a huge circular ring of crimson fire-like light swept by her blade, and a burst of white-orange sparks where it smashes the commander's sword out of his hands. She drops to the ground, blade raised.
SHOT 14 (00:26.5-00:28.5) — Lightning on the stones. Low front angle close to the ground: she lands in a deep low crouch, blade angled down to the stones. MUST SHOW: branching crimson lightning racing out from the blade across the wet stone slabs in every direction, the whole floor veined with glowing red cracks; soldiers in the background hesitate, then charge.
SHOT 15 (00:28.5-00:29.3) — Back into the fight. Camera whips with her as she surges up into the charging soldiers, cutting a fresh crimson arc through the closest ones in a blur of sparks. Hard end mid-motion: no victory pose, no fade.

SOUND: no music at all. Wind across the courtyard and distant rolling thunder throughout; slow footsteps on wet stone and a low hum from the glowing blade in shot 1; then sharp sword clashes, metal armor impacts, bodies hitting wet stone, splashes, blade whooshes, soldiers shouting battle cries, a rising electrical crackle and buzz on the lightning in shots 7 and 14, deep shockwave booms on the sweep and the spinning slash. No dialogue.
prompt_short: Photoreal samurai epic, 16:9, blood moon: a cold young swordswoman with a high black ponytail and a glowing crimson katana cuts through an armored army in a wet castle courtyard, crimson lightning, sparks, flips over a horned commander. No music.
